bias_and_scope_disclosure: Manual labels were assigned by the lab author (Vũ Trí Dũng) rather than an independent third-party annotator, introducing potential self-evaluation bias despite anchoring scores to explicit chunk text and pre-registered evidence clauses.

Grounding quality measures whether top-3 retrieved chunks contain sufficient verbatim evidence to support a faithful, traceable answer; it does NOT evaluate end-to-end LLM generation accuracy (no LLM answer generator is part of this ingestion benchmark).

coherence_rubric.0: Cut mid-idea or missing essential subject/predicate so standalone meaning is broken or misleading.
coherence_rubric.1: Partially understandable, but truncated at boundaries, retains unrelated trailing fragment, or misses antecedent/closing context.
coherence_rubric.2: Self-contained and coherent semantic unit with intact sentence/paragraph boundaries.

grounding_rubric.0: Top-3 retrieved chunks lack the evidence required to answer the question.
grounding_rubric.1: Top-3 retrieved chunks contain partial evidence only (missing a required clause, item, or condition).
grounding_rubric.2: Top-3 retrieved chunks contain complete evidence to answer accurately and trace back to exact source/page/section.
